from pathlib import Path
sig = bytes.fromhex('0d0a0d0a000d0a515549540a')
# Try malformed v2 lengths around boundary and with minimal HTTP tail.
for ln in [0,1,4,8,12,13,14,15,16,20,30,100,200,512,4095]:
    hdr = sig + bytes([0x21,0x11]) + ln.to_bytes(2,'big')

    payload = b'A'*max(0, ln-12)
    http = b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: x\r\n\r\n'
    Path(f'/workspace/probe_{ln}.bin').write_bytes(hdr + addr + payload + http)
print('wrote probes')
